title: Recruitment of Officers in Grade 'A' and Grade 'B' (General and Specialist Stream) 2026
organization: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
salary_range: Assistant Manager Grade 'A': ₹62500 - ₹126100 (Approx ₹1,20,000/- p.m. gross); Manager Grade 'B': ₹78450 - ₹141600 (Approx ₹1,45,000/- p.m. gross)
application_fee: Refer to official notification details for category-wise fee structure
age_limit: Grade 'A': Not below 21 years and not exceeding 30 years (born between 1996-11-21 and 2005-11-21); Grade 'B': Not below 25 years and not exceeding 33 years (born between 1993-11-21 and 2001-11-21) as on November 21, 2026.

summary: SIDBI invites online applications from eligible candidates for filling up 68 vacancies of officers in Grade 'A' and Grade 'B' under General and Specialist Streams for 2026-27. Candidates meeting the prescribed educational qualifications and age limits can apply online through the official IBPS registration portal before December 11, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Nationality: Citizen of India, subject of Nepal/Bhutan, Tibetan refugee, or eligible person of Indian origin.

Educational Qualification: Varies by post/stream including Graduation in Commerce/Economics/Mathematics/Statistics/Business Administration/Engineering with minimum 60% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwBD), CS, CMAs, CFA, CA, or MBA/PGDM, along with requisite post-qualification work experience where applicable.
Age Limit: Grade 'A' officers must be 21-30 years old; Grade 'B' officers must be 25-33 years old as of November 21, 2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.
how_to_apply_steps: Carefully read all instructions contained in the official advertisement on www.sidbi.in.
Access the online registration gateway through the official link provided on the website.
Fill out the ON-LINE application form with accurate details and upload necessary documents.
Pay the applicable requisite fee/intimation charges through online mode before the deadline.
Submit the completed application form and retain a printout or copy for future reference.
